FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD/15/ GLH/2021 Dated: 31-01-2022 regarding
altering the limits of BALKUNDI village of ILKAL Taluk and BAGALKOT District and
constituting a new revenue village called ISHWARNAGAR AND HOSUR was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the
Karanataka Gazette No. PR 106 dated:04-02-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated 06-08-2023
And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here by makes the following
notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas specified in column
(2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of BALKUNDI village of ILKAL taluk in
BAGALKOT District to form a new revenue village called ISHWARNAGAR of ILKAL taluk
BAGALKOT district along with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 181GLH2022 dated: 12/10/2022
regarding altering the limits of Nagur Village of Kamalapur Taluk, Kalaburagi
District and constituting a new revenue village called Monu nayak thanda was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 181GLH2022 dated:
13/10/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi District.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 13/10/2022 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received ;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Nagoor of Kamalapur taluk in Kalburgi District to form a new revenue
village called as Monu nayak thanda of Kamalapur taluk Kalburgi District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of BALAKUNDI Village of
SIRUGUPPA Taluk, BALLARI District and to constitute a new revenue

villages called VENKATA KRISHNAIAH CAMP as specified in schedule
along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village of of BALLARI District SIRUGUPPA Taluk BALLARI District to form
a new revenue village called VENKATA KRISHNAIAH CAMP Village of
SIRUGUPPA Taluk, BALLARI District along with the survey numbers included in
column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 337 GLH 2022 Dated 12-10-2022
regarding altering the limits of JAMAGA(R) village of Aland Taluk and Kalaburagi
District and constituting a new revenue village called RAMANAGAR TANDA was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 337 GLH 2022 dated
12-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected
thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburagi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 14/10/2022 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Jamaga(R) said village of Aland taluk in Kalaburagi District to form a new
revenue village called as Ramanagar Tanda of Aland taluk Kalaburagi District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Kadani
Village of Kalabuagi taluk Kalaburagi District and to constitute a new revenue
village called Kadani Tanda as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburagi District, Kalaburagi

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Kadani of Kalaburagi taluk in Kalaburagi District to form a new revenue
village called Kadani tanda of Kalaburagi taluk Kalaburagi district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 374 PFH 2022 Dated:
5.12.2023 regarding altering the limits Tarakaspet village of Chitthapur Taluk and
Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called Golanayak Tanda ,

Shampur halli Tanda, Pushpa somala Tanda and Harischandra Tanda was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 374 PFH 2022
Dated: 5.12.2023 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Kalaburgi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 5.12.2023 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Tarkaspeth of Chitthapur taluk in Kalaburgi District to form a new revenue
village called as Gola Nayak Tanda of Chitthapur taluk Kalaburgi District along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 100 PFH 2022
Dated: 5.01.2023 regarding altering the limits of ARANAKAL village of Kalagi
Taluk and Kalaburagi District and constituting a new revenue village called
HANUMAN Nagar And ESWAR NAGAR was published as required by section 6
of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the
Karnataka Gazette No. RD 100 PFH 2022 Dated: 5.01.2023 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from
the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Kalaburagi district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 5.01.2023 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Ratkal of Kalgi taluk in Kalaburgi District to form a new revenue village

called as Hanuman Nagar And Eshwar Nagar of Kalgi taluk Kalaburagi District
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Ankalaga Village of Jewargitaluk Kalaburgi District and to constitute a new revenue
village called Ram Nagaras specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Kalaburgi District, Kalaburgi

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Ankalaga of Jewargi taluk in Kalaburgi District to form a new revenue
village called Ram Nagar of Jewargi taluk Kalaburgi district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.
